description: Bland-Altman plot (matplotlib): ADC difference vs mean ADC (x 10^-6 mm^2/s) for four ROI groups as filled markers (orange circles, green down-triangles, red squares, purple plus signs), a thick solid black bias line and grey dashed limits of agreement; X 390-910, Y -95..95. Closed box frame (black, ~4 px) with inward ticks on all four sides: majors every 100 / 20 with minors every 20 / 5, light-grey gridlines. Journal figure (Rabe et al. 2024, Radiat Oncol 19:31, Fig. 3 panel c; crop x 0-975, y 482-964 of the publisher's 1961x964 PNG; the shared marker legend above panel a is not included), 975x482 PNG. Hand-labelled by pixel analysis (Pillow/NumPy/SciPy): positions are image pixels, origin top-left, integer = pixel centre, +/- ~1 px. Provenance and licence: fixtures/real/PROVENANCE.md.

xAxis.notes: axisLineRow is the bottom frame line (black, 4 px). Inward majors (13 px) at 400..900 every 100, inward minors (5 px) every 20; all mirrored on the top frame line. Labels 400 ... 900 below; the frame corners are ~390 / ~910 (no tick).

yAxis.notes: axisLineCol is the left frame line (black, 4 px). Inward majors (14 px) at -80..80 every 20, minors (6 px) every 5; mirrored on the right frame line. The marks at 0 and -40 (and the minor at 45) lie inside the 6 px bias / LoA lines and are not visible as marks: 0 and -40 are their gridline centres (rows 208-209 and 287-289 peek out below the lines), 45 is interpolated from the neighbouring marks. Labels use U+2212 minus signs.

knownValues.description: Grey dashed line, rows 113-118, dash ~19 px, gap ~7 px (text: +46)

pitfalls: Negative Y with U+2212 minus signs (long dash) on -20 ... -80.
The thick bias line (6 px) and the dashed limits of agreement hide the 0 and -40 tick marks and gridlines; markers of four colours sit on and across all three lines.
Inward ticks on all four sides of the frame (mirrored), minor ticks every 5 on Y and every 20 on X.
A panel label box "c) highSNR ROIs" with a rounded border sits inside the frame at the top left.
The Y title is rotated and set in two lines with superscripts ("ADC diff. / 10^-6 mm^2 s^-1"); the X title has superscripts too.
